messages.subject: Larkspur - report on title - points for client
messages.plaintextBody:
Sarah,

Drafting the report on title. Main points to flag to Marchwood: the carried-forward service charge deficit (£18,400) - I've built an adjustment into the completion statement; the outstanding Aldermere rent review (conduct to be assigned); and the TOGC conditions (option to tax + HMRC notification before completion). Searches are clear.

I'll have the report to you for review tomorrow.

Elena

messages.plaintextBody:
Good. Make sure the report is explicit that we don't complete until the discharge undertaking is in agreed form. Also confirm the buyer arranges its own insurance from exchange - the contract puts risk on the buyer. Otherwise sounds on track.

Sarah
